company_name: Beijing Electronics Inspection and Metrology Equipment Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized inspection and metrology equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Beijing Electronics Inspection and Metrology Equipment Co., Ltd. offers advanced inspection and metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on wafer pattern defect inspection and advanced packaging defect inspection. Their product portfolio includes automated microscopes and micro/nano topography equipment, catering to both semiconductor and display industries.
